name: centered-word-build
title: Centered Word Build
description: Words appear sharply from below while the centered phrase pushes closer on every beat.
useWhen: A short statement should assemble one word at a time while every visible prefix stays centered and pushes closer.
Beat-synced typography where words appear sharply but still travel up into place.
avoidWhen: Each new word should drive the existing line aside: use word-push.
Words should replace one another in the same fixed slot: use per-word-crossfade.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Short statement assembled one word at a time.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Word gap
variables.description: Frames before the second and third words (30 fps).

variables.label: Acceleration
variables.description: Each later gap is this fraction of the previous one.

variables.label: Rise
variables.description: How far below its place each word starts, in font sizes.

variables.label: Zoom step
variables.description: Extra scale the camera pushes in on every new word.

variables.label: Settle frames
variables.description: Frames each word takes to settle (30 fps).

variables.label: Exit at
variables.description: Frame where the soft left-to-right wipe starts (30 fps).
